attributes.action: Return Voltron Legendary Defenders 2016 to Netflix
attributes.additional_details:
Voltron Legendary Defenders was so inspirationally ahead of its time, with its inclusion of LGBTQ characters, the diversity amongst race and the information shared of character’s different backgrounds.

PLEASE BRING VOLTRON BACK!!!
attributes.background: I wish for the UK government to rightfully bring Voltron back to Netflix as not only did it shape so many young minds but it helped to break down the reality of social norms and introduce sensitive themes to the younger generations.
